context_requirements: Proliferative capacity to reveal anti-proliferative consequences
falsifiers: No change in proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression at 24 h
No induction of stress-response genes at either time point
Strong and selective upregulation of ribosomal protein genes
Line-to-line responses uncorrelated with proliferation rate or ribosome biogenesis

changes: Removed TRIB3, CHAC1, DDIT4, SQSTM1, and DNAJB1 from late_up because they are already listed in proximal_up and a gene must not appear in both an up and a down list of the same time; they remain in proximal_up.
Removed RPS6KA1/2/3 as primary targets: these are p90 ribosomal S6 kinases, not ribosomal proteins, so they are not the direct target of a ribosomal protein inhibitor.

Kept the direction of immediate-early and stress genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1, IER3, ATF5, DDIT4, TRIB3, CHAC1, SQSTM1, HSPA1A, DNAJB1, HSPB1, BAG3, NFKBIA, ZFP36) as up, consistent with ribosome stress/ISR activation.

Kept the direction of proliferation and cell-cycle genes (MYC, CCND1, CCND3, CCNE2, E2F2, MYBL2, MCM3, PCNA, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, BIRC5) as down, consistent with impaired ribosome biogenesis and growth arrest.
Kept CDKN1A, GADD45A, GADD45B, TSC22D3, SESN1, SFN, HMOX1, XBP1, HERPUD1, EDEM1 as late_up, consistent with p53-dependent arrest and UPR/oxidative stress responses.
Kept kinetics as sustained and magnitude as weak at 6 h and moderate at 24 h, consistent with a delayed stress and anti-proliferative response to ribosomal inhibition.
Kept line responses as moderate except HA1E weak, consistent with known differences in proliferation rate and ribosome biogenesis capacity.
Removed all evidence citations because none were provided and no abstract was available to support the claims.
